subject: Request: multi-cloud listing concession & credit approval - Aegis Health pilot
messages:
From: Michael Dunn <michael.dunn@aegishealth.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@aegishealth.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 10:13:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot listing + marketplace credit request

Hi Neha,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team was impressed with Redwood's multi-cloud routing and cost controls. We want to move forward with a four-month pilot across our AWS and GCP estates, but procurement needs a marketplace listing and a one-time listing credit to offset initial onboarding fees.

Can Redwood provide a marketplace listing (AWS and GCP) and a $25k credit applied through a private offer or listing concession? Procurement says credits must be documented in the offer and reflected in the marketplace pricing. Attached is our initial mutual action plan (Aegis_MA_plan_v2.pdf).

Would appreciate an outline of the path and an estimated timeline for approvals.

Best,
Michael
Director, Cloud Architecture
Aegis Health

Michael —

Thanks, and great to hear the team liked the demo. I can take this to our marketplace and finance partners. Quick notes:
- We can support private offers on AWS and a listing with a bundled credit on GCP, but approvals vary by cloud and will likely require an exception for the credit flow to appear on the marketplace worksheet.
- I’ll loop in our marketplace leads and finance to start an approval thread; can you confirm the target go-live date for the pilot (preferred start week)?

I’ve attached our initial pricing workup for internal review. I’ll follow up with a proposal timeline by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>

Cc: markus_klein@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Pilot listing + marketplace credit request — approval needed

Team — forwarding Aegis request. Highlights and ask:
- Customer: Aegis Health (large regional health system)
- Request: multi-cloud listing (AWS + GCP) + $25k listing credit to be visible on marketplace/private offer
- ARR profile: pilot expected to convert to a $120k ARR first year if successful (attached MA plan)
- Timeline: target pilot start week of May 17

Can we get: 1) deal desk approval for a $25k one-time marketplace credit, 2) quick confirmation of whether AWS will allow a listing-level credit vs. private-offer credit, and 3) finance sign-off on how to reflect in our revenue/discounting model?

I’ve attached a pricing workup with suggested concession path and impact to ACV. Fastest path would be to treat this as a one-time marketplace concession applied upfront and backed by a signed SOW.

Thanks — Neha

---
Quoted attachments: Aegis_MA_plan_v2.pdf, pricing_workup_neha.xlsx
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 10:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot listing + marketplace credit request — approval needed

Neha / Vanessa —

Thanks for the context. From a deal-desk perspective I can approve a one-time $25k concession for a pilot on the condition that:
1) The concession is time-limited (applies only to this initial pilot term).
2) We capture a signed commercial SOW referencing the credit and listing terms.
3) We document expected ARR waterfall if the pilot converts; cap the cumulative concession at the $25k.

Two clouds: AWS requires us to issue either a private offer with an explicit credit line OR a Marketplace listing with a published discount — AWS legal prefers the private-offer route for one-off credits. GCP's partner team is more flexible and we can show a listing-level credit with a bundled SKU. Both approaches are workable but need cloud partner confirmation.

I’ve added suggested language for the marketplace term sheet (see Marketplace_Term_Sheet_AEGIS.pdf) and flagged revenue treatment with finance.

Ben
Sr. Deal Desk Manager, Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: Marketplace_Term_Sheet_AEGIS.pdf (pdf)
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: markus_klein@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot listing + marketplace credit request — approval needed

Ben —

Finance is OK with the one-time $25k concession under these controls:
- Recognize revenue on the net of the credit only after the pilot SOW is signed and services delivered per SOW milestones.
- Concession must be flagged as a marketplace allowance and tracked in our revenue management ledger (we’ll need the private offer ID or listing SKU).
- Credit payback clause: if customer cancels before 30 days post-launch without cause, the credit is prorated and recovered via invoice.

Assuming those terms hold, finance sign-off granted. Please ensure legal reviews the marketplace/private-offer wording.

Laura Bennett
VP Finance, Redwood Inference
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Michael Dunn <michael.dunn@aegishealth.com>, procurement@aegishealth.com
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2027 15:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Approved: listing credit path and next steps for Aegis pilot

Michael —

Good news: Redwood has approved a one-time $25k marketplace concession for the Aegis pilot. Quick summary of the path and next steps: 
1) AWS: we will publish a private offer with an explicit $25k offer credit applied at purchase. AWS partner team has confirmed private-offer flow is required for this type of one-off credit. AWS partner contact (cc'd partner team) will create the private-offer flow; we will send finalized term-sheet for signatures.
2) GCP: we will list a bundled pilot SKU with the $25k credit applied at checkout (GCP partner team confirmed feasibility).
3) Finance/legal controls: concession tracked in revenue ledger; SOW must reference the credit and include the 30-day prorated recovery clause.

Requested action items for Aegis: please review and confirm pilot start week (target May 17), and sign the attached Marketplace term sheet when ready. Once we have confirmation I’ll coordinate AWS private-offer creation and the GCP listing with the partner teams.

Thanks for moving quickly on this — excited to get you onboarded.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
